question: Which body part do we use to chew our food well before swallowing? 🦷
explanation: Super! We use our strong teeth to bite and chew our food into tiny pieces so it is easy to digest! 🦷
hint: They are white and inside your mouth.

question: Why is it important to chew food properly? 🥣
explanation: Awesome! Chewing food slowly helps our stomach break it down easily and get all the nutrients! 🥣
hint: It helps your tummy work well.

question: Which of these food items is healthy for our body? 🍎
explanation: Great job! Fresh fruits like apples give us vitamins and energy to play all day! 🍎

question: Where does the journey of food begin before it reaches our plate? 🚜
explanation: Super! Farmers grow our fruits and vegetables on the farm before they are sent to market! 🚜

question: Which food group gives us energy to run and jump? 🍞
explanation: Awesome! Carbohydrates found in rice and bread act like fuel for our active bodies! 🍞

question: What helps our body grow and build strong muscles? 🥚
explanation: Great job! Proteins found in eggs and beans are like building blocks for our muscles and bones! 🥚

question: What should we do before eating food to stay clean? 🧼
explanation: Super! Always wash your hands with soap to remove germs before touching your food! 🧼

question: Which organ helps mix the food in our stomach? 🎈
explanation: Awesome! The stomach is like a mixer that turns our food into a soft paste! 🎈

question: What is the best drink to keep us hydrated? 💧
explanation: Great job! Water is the healthiest drink because it keeps our body running perfectly! 💧
hint: It has no sugar or color.

question: Why should we eat plenty of green vegetables? 🥦
explanation: Super! Green vegetables are packed with vitamins that help us stay strong and healthy! 🥦

question: What part of the body do we use to taste our food? 👅
explanation: Awesome! Our tongue has tiny taste buds that help us enjoy the flavor of our meals! 👅

question: What happens if we eat too much junk food? 🍟
explanation: Great job! Junk food lacks nutrients, so it often makes us feel lazy instead of energetic! 🍟

question: How do plants make their own food? ☀️
explanation: Super! Plants use sunlight, water, and air to prepare their own delicious food! ☀️

question: Which of these foods gives our body healthy fats? 🥜
explanation: Awesome! Nuts and seeds provide healthy fats that keep our brain and body working well! 🥜

question: How long should you try to chew a piece of food? ⏳
explanation: Great job! Chewing until the food is soft makes it much easier for your body to process! ⏳

question: Which food group protects us from getting sick? 🍊
explanation: Super! Fruits and vegetables are full of nutrients that act like a shield for our health! 🍊

question: What is our main source of food? 🌾
explanation: Awesome! Almost everything we eat comes from either plants or animals around us! 🌾

question: What helps move food down from the mouth to the stomach? 🧣
explanation: Great job! The food pipe acts like a slide, gently pushing food into your stomach! 🧣

question: Why is breakfast the most important meal? ☀️
explanation: Super! Breakfast gives our body the energy to start the day fresh after a long night! ☀️
hint: The first meal of the day.

question: What is stored in the body for later energy? 🔋
explanation: Awesome! Our body stores extra energy as fat to use when we are active! 🔋

question: Which mineral makes our bones strong? 🥛
explanation: Great job! Calcium found in milk keeps our bones strong and hard! 🥛

question: How many times a day should we eat healthy meals? 🍱
explanation: Super! Eating three balanced meals keeps our energy steady all day long! 🍱

question: What provides the fiber needed for smooth tummy movement? 🌽
explanation: Awesome! Fiber from whole grains helps keep our stomach happy and moving properly! 🌽

question: Where does food go after leaving the stomach? 🧬
explanation: Great job! The small intestine is where food is broken down more to enter our blood! 🧬

question: What is junk food usually high in? 🧂
explanation: Super! Junk food is often loaded with extra salt and sugar which is bad for our body! 🧂
hint: These make it taste yummy but unhealthy.

question: What is the primary job of our digestive system? ⚙️
explanation: Awesome! The digestive system's job is to get energy and nutrients from what we eat! ⚙️

question: What nutrient do fruits give us most? 🍓
explanation: Great job! Fruits are nature's vitamin bombs that keep us fit and active! 🍓

question: How should we eat our food for better health? ⏳
explanation: Super! Eating slowly and calmly lets your stomach know it's time to work and digest! ⏳

question: What kind of food keeps our skin and eyes healthy? 🥕
explanation: Awesome! Orange vegetables like carrots have special nutrients for our eyes! 🥕

question: Which of these foods gives us the most protein? 🥩
explanation: Great job! Meat, fish, and beans are fantastic sources of protein for our muscles! 🥩

question: What should we do with leftovers to avoid waste? 📦
explanation: Super! Storing food properly helps keep it fresh for another meal! 📦

question: Which food group do oils and butter belong to? 🧈
explanation: Awesome! Oils and butter are fats that give our body concentrated energy! 🧈

question: Why is chewing important for the food pipe? 🧣
explanation: Great job! Chewing well makes food small and smooth so it slides down the pipe easily! 🧣

question: What is the benefit of a balanced meal? 🥗
explanation: Super! A balanced meal has a little bit of everything to keep you feeling great! 🥗

question: What do we call the energy we get from food? 🔋
explanation: Awesome! Calories are just the way we measure the energy stored in food! 🔋

question: Why should we avoid eating while watching TV? 📺
explanation: Great job! Watching TV distracts you, so you don't notice when you are full! 📺

question: Which nutrient gives us quick energy? 🍬
explanation: Super! Simple sugars give the body a very fast burst of energy! 🍬

question: What happens to food in our mouth? 🦷
explanation: Awesome! Teeth break food down into smaller pieces to begin the digestion journey! 🦷

question: What should be our snack choice after school? 🍎
explanation: Great job! Fresh fruit is a healthy and natural way to get energy after a long day! 🍎

question: Why do our bodies need different types of food? 🔄
explanation: Super! Our bodies need different nutrients to grow, stay strong, and keep us fit! 🔄

question: What helps move the food paste in the stomach? 🎈
explanation: Awesome! Stomach muscles squeeze and mix the food to help turn it into liquid! 🎈

question: What is the main ingredient of most healthy snacks? 🌽
explanation: Great job! The best snacks are natural foods that haven't been processed with extra stuff! 🌽

question: Which food group is best for energy during sports? 🍞
explanation: Super! Carbohydrates provide the long-lasting energy needed to play sports well! 🍞

question: What do teeth do to food before swallowing? 🦷
explanation: Awesome! Teeth grind and mash food so it's ready to pass through the pipe! 🦷

question: Why is it important to wash vegetables before eating? 🥦
explanation: Great job! Washing vegetables removes hidden dirt and germs from the farm! 🥦

question: Which of these is a healthy protein source for vegetarians? 🥜
explanation: Super! Beans, lentils, and pulses are perfect protein sources for vegetarian growth! 🥜

question: What is the healthiest way to cook vegetables? 🍳
explanation: Awesome! Steaming or boiling keeps all the vitamins inside the vegetables! 🍳

question: Why does the body need rest after eating? 😴
explanation: Great job! Your body uses energy to digest, so being calm helps the process! 😴

question: What nutrient is found most in drinking water? 💧
explanation: Super! Pure water has no nutrients but it is vital for every cell in our body! 💧

question: What makes a healthy diet? 🥗
explanation: Awesome! A variety of foods ensures you get every single nutrient your body needs! 🥗
